description:
Implement the `/changelog` slash command, which renders all changelog entries as formatted Markdown in the chat transcript.

**On-screen result (observed in upstream `tmux pi-comparison` right pane):**
```
─────────────────────────────────────────
  What's New

  ## [0.73.0] ...
  ### Added
  ...
─────────────────────────────────────────
```
Layout: `Spacer(1)` → `DynamicBorder` → `Text(bold+accent "What's New", 1, 0)` → `Spacer(1)` → `Markdown(content, 1, 1)` → `DynamicBorder`. Markdown is rendered with 1-space left and right indent.

**Upstream source:** `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts` `handleChangelogCommand()` (~line 5085):
1. Reads changelog via `parseChangelog(getChangelogPath())`
2. Reverses entries so newest appears first, joins with `"\n\n"`
3. Falls back to `"No changelog entries found."` when empty
4. Calls `this.chatContainer.addChild(new Markdown(changelogMarkdown, 1, 1, this.getMarkdownThemeWithSettings()))`

**What to implement in Elixir:**
- `dispatch_slash_command("changelog", state)` in `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex`
  - Read CHANGELOG.md (embed at compile time or read from `Application.app_dir/2`)
  - Append a transcript message containing the Markdown-rendered content
- Add `%SlashCommand{name: "changelog", description: "Show changelog entries"}` to `builtin_commands/0` in `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/autocomplete.ex`
title: Port /changelog command
